its own file, so adding pure models cannot silently drop an old characterization.
The historical output path/artifact remains compatible and now includes both phases.
Phase C adds its own executed bucket while retaining those frozen inventories.
Phase D adds an independent handler/differential/ARM bucket, without losing earlier counts.
Phase E adds executed orchestration, readback, real-Video and historical-cache buckets.

Phase G adds startup/boot/metadata/reset and post-restore Cloud execution without changing prior buckets.

M6 C adds only its separately inventoried WALL runtime suites; all earlier counts remain required.

    phase_b_path = root / '.github/scripts/m4-phase-b-baseline.json'
    phase_b = json.loads(phase_b_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if phase_b_path.exists() else {'phaseBSuites': {}}

    phase_d_path = root / '.github/scripts/m4-phase-d-baseline.json'
    phase_d = json.loads(phase_d_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if phase_d_path.exists() else {'phaseDSuites': {}}
    phase_e_path = root / '.github/scripts/m4-phase-e-baseline.json'
    phase_e = json.loads(phase_e_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if phase_e_path.exists() else {'phaseESuites': {}}
    phase_f_path = root / '.github/scripts/m4-phase-f-baseline.json'
    phase_f = json.loads(phase_f_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if phase_f_path.exists() else {'phaseFSuites': {}}
    phase_g_path = root / '.github/scripts/m4-phase-g-baseline.json'
    phase_g = json.loads(phase_g_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if phase_g_path.exists() else {'phaseGSuites': {}}
    sony_path = root / '.github/scripts/m4-phase-g-sony-corrective-baseline.json'

    m5_phase_c = json.loads((root / '.github/scripts/m5-phase-c-baseline.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

        raise ValueError('C differential inventory differs from B')

            raise ValueError('Raw C differential trace mismatch')

        'referenceHead': baseline['referenceHead'],
        'jvm': counts,
        'retainedCases': sum(baseline['existingSuites'].values()),
        'phaseACases': sum(baseline['phaseASuites'].values()),
        'phaseBCases': sum(phase_b['phaseBSuites'].values()),
        'phaseCCases': sum(phase_c['phaseCSuites'].values()),
        'phaseDCases': sum(phase_d['phaseDSuites'].values()),
        'phaseECases': sum(phase_e['phaseESuites'].values()),
        'phaseFCases': sum(phase_f['phaseFSuites'].values()),
        'phaseGCases': sum(phase_g['phaseGSuites'].values()),
        'phaseGCorrectiveCases': sum(sony['phaseGCorrectiveSuites'].values()),
        'm5PhaseBCases': sum(m5_phase_b['m5PhaseBSuites'].values()),
        'm5PhaseDCases': sum(m5_phase_d['m5PhaseDSuites'].values()),
        'm6PhaseBCases': sum(m6_phase_b['m6PhaseBSuites'].values()),
        'm6PhaseCCases': sum(m6_phase_c['m6PhaseCSuites'].values()),

        'm5PhaseCCases': sum(m5_phase_c['m5PhaseCSuites'].values()),
        'm5PhaseCDifferential': candidate_journal,
        'm5PhaseCHashMapRawPairs': c_hashmap,
        'suites': suites,
        'skippedCases': skipped,
        'fixtureSha256': baseline['fixtureSha256'],
    }
    destination = root / 'app/build/reports/m4-phase-a-summary.json'
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

        print('Opt-in SKIP: ' + name)
    return 1 if counts['FAIL'] else 0


def main():
    """Use a repository-relative root so local Gradle and GitHub Actions share the same proof."""
    return summarize(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError, ET.ParseError):
        print('Phase A/B/C/D/E/F/G report validation failed; no payload or exception message emitted', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

name: Android debug APK

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - work/tv-pairing-authenticated-lan-001
      - work/tv-cloud-client-001
      - kiro/tv-product-hardening-001
      # Temporary (0.10A runtime integration): run debug CI on the runtime regie branch.
      # Remove once the 0.10A runtime integration PR has landed.
      - kiro/overlay-manifest-runtime-integration-0.10a-001
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  debug:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      # `secrets` is not available in step-level `if:` expressions, so expose the
      # "are ALL FOUR stable-signing secrets configured" boolean as an env var here and
      # gate the optional signing steps on it below. This is true only when every one of
      # the keystore Base64, keystore password, key alias, and key password secrets is
      # non-empty; a partial set leaves signing disabled so CI cannot half-configure it.
      # Only the boolean result is exposed here; no secret value is ever surfaced.
      SIGNING_ENABLED: ${{ secrets.SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 != '' && secrets.SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD != '' && secrets.SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS != '' && secrets.SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD != '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"
      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v4
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: "8.9"
      - name: Install Android SDK 35
        run: sdkmanager "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0"
      - name: Check POC boundary
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
      - name: Build and lint debug APK (Cloud not configured)
        run: gradle :app:assembleDebug :app:lintDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest --stacktrace
      - name: Verify Phase A/B/C/D/E/F/G executed test counts and frozen fixtures
        run: python3 .github/scripts/m4-phase-a-test-summary.py
      - name: Preserve actual executed JVM XML and the M6 interop golden
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: scenevibe-m6-phase-d-jvm-evidence
          path: |
            app/build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest/TEST-*.xml
            app/src/test/resources/m6/banner-package-assignment.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Upload bounded Phase A/B/C/D/E/F/G test summary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: scenevibe-m4-phase-a-test-summary
          path: app/build/reports/m4-phase-a-summary.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Build LAN DEV APK (prove SCENEVIBE_ENABLE_LAN_DEV still compiles)
        env:
          # Developer-only LAN prototype surface. NOT a consumer build and NOT a secret.
          # This step only proves the ENABLE_LAN_DEV=true path still compiles; its APK is
          # not uploaded (the uploaded artifact is the Cloud qualification build below).
          SCENEVIBE_ENABLE_LAN_DEV: "true"
        run: gradle :app:assembleDebug --stacktrace
      - name: Build Cloud qualification APK
        env:
          # Stable public SceneVibe origin (NOT a secret): compiles the uploaded APK
          # against the real Cloud endpoint so it is usable for physical qualification.
          # M1 pre-physical candidate pinned to Cloud PR #19 commit 402f781d7e3bccd10807de8e8ce1dd0d81ec5162.
          SCENEVIBE_CLOUD_ORIGIN: https://interface-scenevibe-3wxg-gezccb341-archc-ode.vercel.app
        run: gradle :app:assembleDebug --stacktrace
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: scenevibe-tv-companion-cloud-qualification-debug
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      # --- Stable APK signing (optional, secret-gated) ---------------------------------
      # These steps run ONLY when all four stable-signing secrets are configured in the
      # repository. When they are absent the workflow above already produced and uploaded
      # the (debug-signed) Cloud qualification APK, so standard CI passes unchanged.
      # No keystore, private key, password, or Base64 material is committed to the repo:
      # the keystore is decoded into RUNNER_TEMP at runtime and discarded with the runner.
      - name: Decode stable signing keystore into RUNNER_TEMP
        id: stable_keystore
        if: ${{ env.SIGNING_ENABLED == 'true' }}
        env:
          SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          KEYSTORE_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/scenevibe-stable.jks"
          printf '%s' "$SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > "$KEYSTORE_PATH"
          echo "keystore_path=$KEYSTORE_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Sign Cloud qualification APK with stable key
        id: stable_sign
        if: ${{ env.SIGNING_ENABLED == 'true' }}
        env:
          SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SCENEVIBE_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          KEYSTORE_PATH: ${{ steps.stable_keystore.outputs.keystore_path }}
        run: |
          BUILD_TOOLS_DIR="$(ls -d "$ANDROID_HOME"/build-tools/35.0.0)"
          APKSIGNER="$BUILD_TOOLS_DIR/apksigner"
          UNSIGNED_APK="app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
          SIGNED_APK="$RUNNER_TEMP/scenevibe-tv-companion-cloud-qualification-stable.apk"
          cp "$UNSIGNED_APK" "$SIGNED_APK"
          "$APKSIGNER" sign \
            --ks "$KEYSTORE_PATH" \
